Thanks for the ping — quick triage below.

What I checked:
- Verified invite was generated by the Coupa vendor invite flow (not manual) and targeted liam.oneill@harborworks.io.
- Our IdP (redwood-idp) is sending relayState with a trailing slash that Coupa's portal sometimes normalizes; Okta may be returning a slightly different relayState value.
- Coupa will reject the SAML response if relayState != requestRelayState. Logs attached (redacted) with the SAML request/response IDs: see sso-trace-log.txt.

Workarounds to try now (in order):
1) Vendor: clear site cookies for coupa domain and try the invite link in a new private window (some relayState values are cached).
2) I can reissue the invite but toggle the 'session-less' flag to use a direct accept URL (temporary one-time token). That bypasses the relayState check for initial acceptance.
3) If the above fails I'll coordinate a short Coupa support SR — I suspect a relayState normalization edge for older Coupa tenants.

Liam (cc'd), can you try step #1 and report back? If you prefer I'll create the one-time accept URL and paste it here.

Rishi Malhotra
Identity & Access Engineer, Redwood Inference
